build_quantize_model: build a quantized PyTorch model using quantize with a prepared module and qconfig
create_prepare_model: create a prepared model for post-training quantization using prepare with qconfig dict
run_quantize_dynamic: run dynamic quantization on a PyTorch model using quantize_dynamic on specified module types
refactor_prepare_qat_model: refactor a PyTorch model for quantization-aware training using prepare_qat with qconfig
test_convert_model: test converting a prepared model to final quantized model using convert
